regressions.name: Public availability on a normal day (2026-11-22, party 2)
regressions.notes: GET /reservations/availability with Origin http://acme.menuza.test:3008 and XFF 10.62.1.1 -> 200; dayVersion=1, settingsVersion=66, status=available, 36 slots (brunch Sunday), 19:00 offered, no 'closed' object in the body. regressions.name: Public booking end to end (2026-11-25 19:00 party 2) + manage view + public cancel + release
regressions.notes: POST /reservations/holds -> 201 with holdToken; POST /reservations with Idempotency-Key -> 201, confirmation NBDSJWYN, id rsv_e0956615-dcd4-459b-9f81-5ca6fdd9c40a, manageToken present; GET /reservations/manage with X-Reservation-Token -> 200 showing firstName R2E, date 2026-11-25, time 19:00, party 2, status booked; POST /reservations/manage/cancel -> 200 status cancelled; the reservation's occupancy row went active 1 -> 0 and availability after cancel -> 200 with 19:00 offered. Negative: GET /reservations/manage without a token -> 404 uniform. Caveat: 19:00 was also offered before the cancel because many tables fit party 2; the release is proven by the occupancy row, not by the slot appearing.

regressions.name: Typed 409 block_conflict on 2026-11-25 (no raw driver text, nothing persisted)
regressions.notes: Fresh staff booking pinned to tbl_acme_m1 (Main Dining Room), 2026-11-25 19:00 party 2 -> 201 booked (id rsv_f4b41899-be80-4e6a-9f90-7a05977bff29). POST /operator/reservations/setup/blocks with the setup token, area block area_acme_main 18:00-21:30 -> 409 {"error":"block_conflict","message":"The block conflicts with existing reservations","reservationIds":["rsv_f4b41899-be80-4e6a-9f90-7a05977bff29"]}; the raw body contains no 'Failed query' / 'rsv_table_occupancies' text. Nothing persisted: rsv_blocks count for 2026-11-21/22/25 is 0 and the booking was untouched (still booked, occupancy active) — so there was no block to delete. Negatives: POST .../book/reservations without a token -> 401; POST .../setup/blocks without a token -> 401. The probe booking was cancelled afterwards -> 200.

frictions.description: GET /operator/reservations/book/requests does not exist as a GET route (only POST .../requests/:id/approve|decline); the App's Requests panel filters the day feed for pending_approval. The parent's check named it as an option.
frictions.resolution: Used GET /operator/reservations/book/day?locationId=...&date=2026-11-21 with the book token and filtered the reservation rows for pending_approval; both requests were listed.

frictions.description: The public availability endpoint offered the 19:00 slot both before and after cancelling the 2026-11-25 booking because many tables fit party 2, so 'the slot is offered again' cannot by itself prove capacity was released.
frictions.resolution: Corroborated the release with a read-only sqlite check of rsv_table_occupancies (active 1 -> 0 for the cancelled reservation).

summary: 5/5 regression checks pass after af7ffb5a/c043ba8f. Public availability 2026-11-22 -> 200 with slots/dayVersion/settingsVersion and no closed state (no-Origin -> 404); public booking 2026-11-25 19:00 end to end (hold 201 -> book 201 NBDSJWYN -> manage 200 R2E/19:00/p2/booked -> public cancel 200) with the occupancy released; large-party requests on 2026-11-21 -> 201 requested with no raw driver text (an overlapping probe request also booked cleanly), visible in the day feed and declined with a reason; operator availability 2026-11-22 -> 200, closed=false, 141 slots all with suggestedTableIds, plus a staff booking 201 -> cancel 200; the area block over a live booking -> 409 typed block_conflict listing the reservation id with no raw SQL text and nothing persisted. No regressions found; no tokens written to evidence (all saved bodies redacted as <redacted>).
